_note: Per-map light scale (all lights, sun and sky), from comparing the first bake's mean light with Quake 3's own lightmaps (2026-10-22): maps more than 0.85-1.65x the original are pulled to 1.3x (bounce light makes the remaster a little brighter by design). q3map clips bright panels at 255; Godot doesn't, so maps with 4000-10000 surface lights over-light. An object entry adds per-shader surface-light factors (q3dm12: the BFG room's ceiling lamps, at a quarter once their beams stopped trapping their light, Ozmium 2026-10-25: a little dark, with the spotlights' contrast).

_bake._note: LightmapGI settings for maps too big for the default bake: Rustgrad's atlas at texel scale 1 / high quality ran 37 min and failed to save (empty image, 2026-10-24); floor: minimum L0 after the bake (tools/lightmap_floor.py), for q3map2 maps whose light entities were stripped; gain: L0 x gain after the bake (lightmap_floor.py), matched to Q3ClassicMap's brightness
